taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Pairwise subject and sector/client migration into existing local accounts
controls.source_trace: Trace the external stable identity pair into local account selection. Determine whether email/domain/display-name changes can select an unrelated account or skip linking consent.
controls.implementation_branch: Use issuer plus subject as the external identity anchor and inspect the declared linking exception, if any. Email can change or be recycled; a verified-email flag describes a claim, not proof of control of an existing local account. Check re-linking and unlinking, not only first login.
controls.operational_method: Specialize in pairwise-subject/sector or client migration rather than ordinary email linking. Retain old and new issuer/client/sector context, immutable external subject and the approved migration mapping. A changed pairwise sub can legitimately identify the same user only through an authorized mapping; never infer that mapping from a recycled email. Compare approved migration with a new unrelated subject sharing the old display/email label and verify that existing local authority is not reassigned.
controls.controlled_verification: Model an owned client/sector migration with approved old-subject to new-subject mapping, then substitute an unrelated subject sharing only email/display metadata. Compare final local account/authority selection, not login success alone.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Matching verified email can be an explicitly supported linking policy; demonstrate a violated requirement rather than imposing a universal prohibition.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind identities according to the declared linking policy and require the appropriate existing-account proof; retest collisions and intended links.
